fusions.name: Hooding Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted hood that hits the first enemy in its path for 12 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds, its abilities out of reach.

fusions.name: Needle Fan
fusions.desc: Flicks a fan of needles 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds, its attacks slowed. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Behind the Curtain
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 50% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Folded Light
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
